thread.title: Shelby Urban County Policy Board to hold regular meeting on May 13
thread.title_full: Shelby Urban County Policy Board to hold regular meeting on May 13

author: h. r. chandler
title: Shelby Urban County Policy Board to hold regular meeting on May 13
text:
The Shelby Urban County Policy Board will hold its regular meeting on May 13 at 1:00 p.m., according to an announcement released on May 5. The meeting is scheduled to take place at the Shelby County Administration Building, located at 200 West College Street, Room 104, in Columbiana, Alabama.
The upcoming meeting is part of the board’s ongoing efforts to oversee programs and initiatives relevant to the Shelby Urban County area. Regular meetings like this provide an opportunity for board members and the public to discuss policies and updates related to local development projects.
For those seeking more information about the Shelby Urban County or the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program, contact can be made with the Shelby County Department of Development Services via email at cdbg@shelbyal.com or by phone at 205-620-6650. Additional details are available online at www.shelbyal.com/urbancounty.
These meetings are a chance for residents and stakeholders to stay informed about county development activities and participate in local governance processes.
Future announcements regarding agenda items or outcomes from this session may be shared through official county communication channels.
